comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
Huh. Available from the "New Era Premium Bottle". Stats are the same as listed above:

+2 Evasion
+2 Repair
+1 Gunnery

The attack/defense difference from King Lanling Mask - Special is vastly superior, if I'm reading the numbers right, though. Gonna guess this'll be a super rare bottle drop? We'll see in time, I guess.

Source: wiki.ogplanet.com/uwo/index.php?title=New_Era_Premium_Bottle

comments.author: tare
comments.body: It seems like there is no difference between the bottle's Special King Lanling Mask and the astro shop's in terms of att, def and stats. I think OGP gave us two choices, either we spend 999 astros and have a confirmed item or we can simply keep randoming the bottles which may turn into an exponentially expensive and rare piece. Either ways, the price are pretty heavy but knowing that now they have included an expensive astro item into a bottle, they might have tweaked the rarity parameters for this mask in the astro bottle to be very rare to match the astro shop. Probably in the long run, buying one off the astro shop might be cheaper as Guilder mentioned.
